courier_profiles_location_pair_check.name: courier_profiles_location_pair_check
courier_profiles_location_pair_check.value:
("courier_profiles"."current_lat" IS NULL) = ("courier_profiles"."current_lng" IS NULL)
        AND ("courier_profiles"."current_lat" IS NULL) = ("courier_profiles"."location_updated_at" IS NULL)

orders_finished_at_check.name: orders_finished_at_check
orders_finished_at_check.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('delivered', 'cancelled', 'rejected') OR "orders"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

support_tickets_subject_length_check.name: support_tickets_subject_length_check
support_tickets_subject_length_check.value: "support_tickets"."subject" IS NULL OR char_length("support_tickets"."subject") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

messages_context_chk.name: messages_context_chk
messages_context_chk.value: "messages"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL

messages_single_context_chk.name: messages_single_context_chk
messages_single_context_chk.value: NOT ("messages"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL)

messages_order_receiver_check.name: messages_order_receiver_check
messages_order_receiver_check.value: "messages"."order_id" IS NULL OR "messages"."receiver_id" IS NOT NULL
